schedulingPollCompareBookingDescription: Booking pages are great for one on one appointments, but they fall short when a whole group needs to agree on a single time.
schedulingPollCompareDescription: There are plenty of ways to schedule a meeting, but most of them start to break down as soon as more than two people are involved.
schedulingPollCompareEmailDescription: Twenty replies deep and still no date. Long email threads make it hard to keep track of who can make it and when.
schedulingPollComparePollDescription: Propose a few times, let everyone vote, and pick the winner. It is the fastest way to schedule a meeting with three or more people.
schedulingPollCompareTitle: The easiest way to plan a meeting with a group
schedulingPollCtaDescription: Create a free scheduling poll in seconds. No login required.
schedulingPollCtaTitle: Ready to find the best time to meet?
schedulingPollFaqAccountAnswer: No. Participants just open the poll link and vote from any device. You do not even need an account to create a poll.
schedulingPollFaqAccountQuestion: Do participants need to create an account?
schedulingPollFaqBookingAnswer: A booking page shares one person's availability so others can pick a slot. A meeting poll gathers the availability of the whole group so you can settle on one time together. For group meetings, a poll is usually the faster option.
schedulingPollFaqBookingQuestion: How is a meeting poll different from a booking page?
schedulingPollFaqFreeAnswer: Yes. Creating a scheduling poll is free and there are no ads. Rallly also offers an optional paid plan with extra features for frequent users, such as keeping polls indefinitely.
schedulingPollFaqLimitAnswer: There is no fixed limit. Rallly works just as well for a group of five as it does for large groups with dozens of participants.
schedulingPollFaqLimitQuestion: How many people can vote on a scheduling poll?
schedulingPollFaqMobileAnswer: Yes. Rallly runs in any modern browser and is designed to work great on mobile, so participants can vote wherever they are.
schedulingPollFaqMobileQuestion: Can I use Rallly on my phone?
schedulingPollFaqNamesAnswer: They are different names for the same idea: a poll that collects everyone's availability so you can find the best time to meet. Whichever name you use, Rallly covers it with one simple tool.
schedulingPollFaqNamesQuestion: What is the difference between a scheduling poll, an availability poll, and a meeting poll?
schedulingPollFaqTimeZonesAnswer: Yes. With time zone support enabled, every participant sees the proposed times in their own time zone and votes are converted automatically.
schedulingPollFaqTimeZonesQuestion: Does Rallly work across time zones?
schedulingPollFaqWhatIsAnswer: A scheduling poll is a simple form that lets a group vote on proposed meeting times. Instead of comparing calendars or trading emails, everyone marks the times they are available and the option with the most votes wins.
schedulingPollFeatureAvailabilityDescrip: See everyone's availability side by side and instantly spot the times that work for the whole group.
schedulingPollFeatureNoAccountDescriptio: Participants just open the link and vote. Share your poll and start collecting responses right away.
schedulingPollFeatureNotificationsDescri: Get notified when participants respond, so you can finalize your plans without chasing people for answers.
schedulingPollFeatureOpenSourceDescripti: Rallly is free to use, shows no ads, and its code is open source, so you always know how your data is handled.
schedulingPollFeaturesDescription: Whether you call it an availability poll, a meeting poll, or a group scheduling tool, Rallly gives you everything you need to find the best time to meet.
schedulingPollFeaturesTitle: Everything you need to schedule group meetings
schedulingPollFeatureTimeZonesDescriptio: Scheduling across time zones? Each participant sees the proposed times in their own time zone, so nobody shows up an hour late.
schedulingPollFeatureVotingDescription: Participants can answer with yes, no, or if need be, so you can tell a perfect time apart from a possible one.
schedulingPollHowItWorksDescription: Rallly is a free meeting scheduler that helps your group agree on a time in three simple steps.
schedulingPollHowItWorksTitle: How to create a scheduling poll
schedulingPollStep1Description: Choose the dates and times you can offer. Add as many options as you like, with or without specific times.
schedulingPollStep2Description: Send the poll link to your group by email or chat. Participants vote on their availability from any device without creating an account.
schedulingPollStep3Description: Votes appear in real time, so you can spot the option that works for everyone and lock in the best time to meet.
schedulingPollUseCaseClassesDescription: Teachers, coaches, and organizers use meeting polls to find the session times that most participants can attend.

schedulingPollUseCasesTitle: A scheduling tool for every kind of group
